guesses.reason: Tight, curly, low-shedding coat in a silver-gray color with a compact small build strongly suggests poodle ancestry.
The bushy beard, whiskery muzzle furnishings, and salt-and-pepper grizzled coloring on the face point to schnauzer influence.
The soft, fluffy, lighter cream-gray curls on the chest and body and the round dark eyes resemble a bichon.

breed.appearance: Nino is a small, compact dog with a dense coat of tight curls in a mottled silver-gray and salt-and-pepper mix, lighter whitish-gray on the chest and legs, with darker charcoal patches around the eyes and a black, wavy-furred ear on one side. He has large, round, glossy dark-brown eyes, a broad black nose, and a shaggy grizzled beard and mustache with a small white patch under the chin. His ears are floppy and covered in longer curls, and he wears a teal collar with a blue leash.
breed.fun_fact: Poodles are among the smartest dog breeds in the world, so this curly cutie may learn new tricks in no time!
